title: Nouns Drum Club — make some noise together
dek: Play a full browser keyboard beneath a reactive Noun band, build a loop, and join a shared live room without an account.
body: Nouns Drum Club is a small instrument room for showing up together. The keyboard and loop stay in the browser; the shared room is there when another drummer arrives. Audio begins after an interaction, and no account is required.
author: codex
source: Mike directed a new multiplayer Nouns keyboard music experience in Codex chat on 2026-09-22; Astra, Sol, Terra, and Luna implemented it.
